{"code": "print("Stratum-specific risk differences (F - M) in percentage points:")
for sev in df_treatment['severity'].unique():
    sub = df_treatment[df_treatment['severity'] == sev]
    p_f = sub[sub['sex'] == 'F']['responded'].mean()
    p_m = sub[sub['sex'] == 'M']['responded'].mean()
    rd = p_f - p_m
    print(f"{sev}: {rd:.4f} ({rd*100:.2f}%)")"}
